messages:
jon: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — creating a tiny action list so we don't lose momentum. posting here for visibility :spiral_calendar:
elaine: I'll take ownership of reconnect logic changes. plan: conservative resume window + client-visible resume token. target: 2026-04-05.
priya: ok I'll do the server handshake change. idea: short-lived nonce with server-verified offset, retries=4, jittered backoff. will add feature flag. due: 2026-04-06.
mike: i'll own observability: partial-response ratio + p95 latency for streaming. add a dashboard and an alert. tentative prom rule below.
ross: mike, please make the alert actionable — include runbook link and recommended mitigation (route-fallback).
mike: draft prom rule: `sum(increase(chat_stream_partial_count[10m])) / sum(increase(chat_stream_request_count[10m])) > 0.06` -> fires after 2m for 5m. will refine.
elaine: reconnect details: keep last-ack seq + 256-token soft buffer, on reconnect try resume, if mismatch fall back to full non-streaming replay. clients should expose onResume callback.
priya: server backoff config i'm testing: ```json
{"retries":4,"backoff_ms":[100,300,900,2700],"handshake_ttl_s":45}
```
jon: ops ask — infra: can we enable jemalloc on stream-hot pods in canary? GC spikes were called out in the PM.
engbot: /action created: enable-jemalloc-canary (owner: infra-canary)	6h check schedule	status: open
ross: also we discussed a temporary model-fallback when streaming error rate >4% for 15m. infra should expose a toggle so we can safely flip.
engbot: /action created: model-fallback-toggle (owner: infra-release)	check interval: 60s TTL: 1h
elaine: i'll run staging soak for handshake+resume flow after Priya's PR merges. ETA: 48h. will attach transcripts and diff logs.
priya: PR stub: refs #2102. i'll tag reviewers and add compatibility matrix for older SDKs (node <=1.2, python <=1.0).
mike: small addition: alert should include per-region breakdown because we've seen regional hotspots. will add labels and panel.
jon: ok action summary (ISO dates): 1) elaine: reconnect+buffer impl (due 2026-04-05). 2) priya: server handshake+backoff PR (due 2026-04-06). 3) mike: observability+alerts (due 2026-04-03). 4) infra: jemalloc canary + model-fallback toggle (due 2026-04-04).
ross: please add a one-liner to the incident tracker when you hit each milestone (todo/in-progress/done). i'll run a 1:1 sync next Wed to verify.
elaine: tracker update when done: "reconnect impl merged  #2108"
priya: tracker: "handshake PR opened  #2102  in review"
mike: tracker: "alerts/dash created  pending threshold tuning"
engbot: /note: automated canary sweep scheduled for 2026-04-04 03:00Z
jon: thanks all. post blockers here and i'll escalate. :thumbsup:"
